description: The Water Administration of Montenegro runs a geoportal as the central platform for spatial data on waters, water facilities and water land in its water information system. Layer groups cover river basins, surface and ground waters, the water book, bathing waters, protected areas, pressures, monitoring stations, floods and water facilities. Individual layers include rivers, catchments, lakes, reservoirs, pipelines, groundwater monitoring sites, hydropower and small hydropower plants, wastewater treatment plants, sewer outfalls and collectors, and flood depth and velocity for the 10, 100 and 500 year floods with areas of potentially significant flood risk. A table view exports records to Excel, CSV or PDF. Coverage is Montenegro. Access is free in the browser with no sign-in. Caveats: layers were listed but no layer was opened in the cloud session, and whether downloads or map services exist was not checked. Simulation uses: flood hazard maps and water and wastewater asset locations for exposure studies. Related records: flood hazard maps of the Sava basin in Bosnia and Herzegovina (data-avp-sava-fbih-flood-hazard-maps) and the Croatian Waters geoportal (data-hrvatske-vode-geoportal-flood-hazard-risk-agglomerations).
